answer: The wicker weaver tests every chair by rocking it on two legs, because a chair that rocks on four will tip on three. Rattan basket finisher hurdle warrant rules the rocking: a warrant basket finishers show after finishing bench trials. The anchor is the first rock, the pearl the last before the chair is passed, and the echo is the passing, the chair set among the finished ones. A cheat must rock 53 false chairs and pass 53 false passings.
